visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 2D animated white dog-like character speaking directly to the camera against a white background. (3) The scene shifts to a face-off where the purple character points upward while the white character looks determined; a pink cat character is also visible. (4) The white character is shown holding a thick stack of red envelopes, its eyes wide with excitement and tongue sticking out. (5) A purple character with a facial scar is depicted walking away into green hills while carrying a large red bag of money, leaving the white character crying in the background.
